headline: Vendor breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer data
summary: A cyberattack on a third-party service provider exposed customer information held by Chase, Visa and Mastercard. Chase confirmed the breach, saying the exposed data included customers' personal and marketing information.

claims.statement: A breach at a third-party vendor exposed Chase, Visa and Mastercard customer information.
